all.source_quote: Applicant should meet the minimum age requirement prescribed for the selected course (15 to 45 years)

unmodelled.text: Applicant must be a resident of West Bengal
unmodelled.source_quote: Applicant should be a resident of West Bengal.

unmodelled.text: Applicant should generally be unemployed, underemployed, a school/college dropout, job seeker or person seeking skill upgradation
unmodelled.source_quote: Applicant should generally be unemployed, underemployed, a school/college dropout, job seeker or person seeking ski upgradation.

unmodelled.text: Applicant should meet the minimum educational qualification required for the selected trade or training programme
unmodelled.source_quote: Applicant should meet the minimum educational qualification required for the selected trade or training programme.

unmodelled.text: Women, economically weaker sections, minorities, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and persons with disabilities may receive priority under inclusive skill development objectives
unmodelled.source_quote: Women, economically weaker sections, minorities, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and persons with disabilities may receive priority under inclusive skill development objectives.

unmodelled.text: Applicant must possess basic documents such as identity proof, address proof, educational certificate, bank details and photograph
